The partnership with Qualcomm ensures the model leverages cutting-edge hardware, optimizing performance without compromising user data. Customer trust hinges on secure digital interactions. While the tech isn't without its challenges, particularly in real-time accuracy, the potential benefits for digital marketing and consumer engagement are significant.
